summary: Iteration 14: Frontend-only test of the '/' command palette shortcut + active-link highlighting on account menu, app rail, and contextual sidebar. All 10 acceptance checks PASS with 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile top-bar search icon uses aria-label='Search' but does NOT carry data-testid='global-search' (only the desktop top-bar button does). It still opens the palette correctly, but adding the same data-testid to the mobile button would improve testability consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at 1440x900 (primary) and 390x844 (mobile). Detailed pass matrix: (1) '/' with focus on body opens data-testid=command-palette with INPUT focused; typing 'wallet' filters to ~2 items; Enter navigates to /wallet and closes palette. (2) Ctrl+K opens palette; typing 'a/b' inside palette input yields value 'a/b' (slash typed normally, no reset). (3) Escape closes palette. (4) Desktop data-testid=global-search button present and opens palette on click. (5) '/' pressed while a text input is focused does NOT open palette. (6) On /wallet: user-menu-wallet has aria-current='page' and active brand class; user-menu-domains aria-current=null. On /domains the states swap correctly. (7) rail-wallet has app-rail-item-active on /wallet and rail-domains has active on /domains; opposite is false on each. (8) Contextual sidebar Dashboard link: class='sidebar-items active' aria-current='page' on /dashboard, class='sidebar-items ' aria-current=null on /domains — no longer permanently active. (9) Mobile 390x844: top-bar search icon (aria-label='Search', no data-testid) opens the same command palette. (10) 0 console errors across the entire flow.
